verdict.rationale: HelixDB ships both vector indexes (dense ANN) and text indexes (durable BM25) in the same engine, and docs claim you can traverse/filter a candidate set before vector ranking and keep 'connected entities, semantically similar content, and exact terms' together (helixdb-docs-3, helixdb-docs-4, helixdb-docs-5, helixdb-docs-14, helixdb-probe-1). However, there is no concrete example of a single query that fuses dense vector scores and BM25 scores together with an explicit fusion/re-ranking algorithm (e.g., RRF or weighted blending) — the evidence shows the two index types existing side-by-side, not a documented combined hybrid-fusion query pattern. Missing for 10: an actual hybrid query syntax/example that runs vector + BM25 together and produces a fused ranked result, and any independent/community confirmation that this fusion capability works as described.
